status: Source preflight only, not implementation or acceptance. Wait for accepted P06 before source edits.
original_exit: Physical camera state is typed until actual physics/render/math projection, without duplicate camera time or length owners.
observed_trace: CameraRigConfig/CameraProfile authored float metres -> blend_profile -> CameraPoseHistory retained focus/shoulder/boom values and velocities -> CameraFrame/CameraPlacement -> native sweeps and Transform.
CameraRigDebugState and CameraAimState retain the same physical points/measures -> debug.rs Gizmos and ui.rs final formatting/projection.
animation_capture_camera_offset -> animation_viewer/view.rs native Transform; tactical_scene_viewer/camera_obstruction.rs builds the same frame/recovery at capture boundaries.

owners.time: AnimationElapsed and ResponseShapingTime, already checked; retain existing clamp, reverse/zero policy and operation order
owners.missing_vector_velocity_owner: No exact checked vector velocity found in searched core/tactical/spatial owners. Inspect all relevant owners before adding one; prefer a shared scene-frame velocity owner consuming the canonical signed-speed contract, not a camera-only copy.
owners.screen_window: Normalized screen coordinates are not metres. Do not reuse physical vectors/lengths or infer an upper bound of one from defaults.
owners.rotation: Inspect canonical RigidRotation and local-to-scene frame semantics before deciding which quaternion retention belongs to the actual framework port.

specific_implementation_sequence: Pin the current source and finish constructor/caller enumeration, including feature-gated debug/UI, viewer captures, all fixtures and unchanged helpers. Check existing type owners before writing types.

Admit authored physical leaves once at config/profile literal boundaries. Preserve signed offsets, velocities and valid zero. Old public float fields do not establish positivity; do not silently restrict a finite signed/zero contract or quantize to integer millimetres. State every deliberate newly rejected invalid value explicitly.

Propagate checked leaves through blend_profile and observation-backed history, including last anchor, focus velocity and shoulder velocity. Preserve independent profile-blend advancement and subject/teleport reset rules.

Carry checked point/offset/measure owners through CameraFrame.endpoint, CameraVolume sweeps, BoomRecovery reset/retract/recover/place and CameraPlacement. Preserve sweep order, close-framing interpolation, 8-sweep budget, native hit precedence, hold/hysteresis and successful exact analytic damping order. Prepare checked replacements before mutating their owner.

Keep critical_damp_scalar/critical_damp_vec3 as genuine complete numerical formula kernels only if receiver-body inspection justifies their native inputs. Typed application wrappers must not merely forward raw measures. Dimensionless filter scratch coefficients can remain primitive; named physical state cannot.

Trace aim/debug records to Gizmos/Transform/physics casts and final UI formatting, including existing fake zero normal/point plus hit flags. Inspect the missing-controller active-aim path: active is set before controller lookup and can retain stale endpoints; absence must not impersonate a current observation. Preserve real origin/identity values.

Adapt existing camera collision, smoothing, mode and capture fixtures without adding tests/helpers/cases/assertions. Add their existing commands to hosted selection if needed. Preserve their obstacle geometry, inputs, iteration budgets and tolerances.

Complete the source family and source-backed compact trace before any formatting/size/CI work. Then focused Code/Rule/producer review, preservation metadata and hosted relevant existing checks; no Comment Review, new agents or fourth full audit wave.
pre_edit_open_questions: Choose scalar length bounds from actual accepted contracts, not names/default values alone. Negative shoulder/body offsets and signed speeds are intentional.
Resolve frame ownership for camera-local right/up/muzzle offsets, world vectors, scene points and velocity. Do not label all Vec3 as scene displacement.
Check which debug/aim absence states need payload ownership and which booleans are ordinary predicates or native flags. Do not invent a broad unrelated camera-mode redesign.
Confirm the precise owning camera geometry error and effect of failed preparation without global-transaction claims.
Enumerate all camera-related capture/report handoffs so P17 remains distinct without hiding a producer propagation gap.
validation_limits: No current P08 implementation or CI pass is claimed.
Existing native collision and smoothing tests are behavioral evidence; no calibrated/live production camera verdict is currently available.
Source lookup commands containing guessed nonexistent paths were corrected by rg --files; failed searches are not coverage evidence.

latest_source_recheck.head: 3ef06860d9a911ccc2ae8e3a0114b5a6e4979666
latest_source_recheck.status: Source planning only; no P08 source edit and no implementation acceptance. Original P08 exit unchanged.

decisions_and_candidates.decision: Reuse SignedLength, Position<Scene>, Displacement<Scene>, RigidRotation and SignedSpeed. RigidRotation::from_quaternion preserves admitted bits and rejects malformed/nonunit input; do not normalize valid camera rotations on admission. Existing finite SignedLength constructor can become const without changing its error/bit contract to support checked authored defaults.

decisions_and_candidates.source: building-generator Cargo.toml, tactical-core dependencies, body_values.rs, core linear_speed.rs
decisions_and_candidates.decision: No exact scene-frame vector-velocity owner found. Proposed owner is shared tactical-core scene_coordinates (which already consumes geometry frames and core speeds), with named east/up/north SignedSpeed components and native Vec3 admission/encoding only at kernels/framework ports. Do not add a dependency from building geometry to strategic core merely for this one camera use. Existing BodyLocalVelocity is explicitly body-local and cannot be reused as scene velocity; do not alias or mislabel its frame.

Near-plane inverse projection uses view coordinates, whereas muzzle offset z means forward along a planar aim basis. Keep these meanings distinct. A camera view frame can own local collider-centre Displacement; muzzle and close-offset records should use named right/up/forward SignedLength leaves rather than relabelling them scene coordinates.

blend_velocity is retained signed fraction/second state, not local scratch. Include it in P08 admission and propagation. Existing ResponseRate and PhaseCorrectionRate are nonnegative and have different roles; neither fits reversal. Resolve a focused signed blend-derivative owner at smoothing ownership instead of keeping the raw retained f32 or reusing a phase role.

Use optional complete observation payloads for absent/current debug and aim state. Collision entity/normal and soft entity/point belong together. Clear absence before lookup and publish a complete new observation after preparation. The existing blocked predicate depends only on camera/muzzle hit identities; remove its unused point arguments and derive the predicate from the observation instead of retaining redundant blocked state.

No matching checked screen owner found. NDC window extents are nonnegative dimensionless quantities with no inferred upper bound of one; screen error is signed and may be off-screen. Keep these separate from metres and bounded UnitInterval. Inspect all existing fixture/config mutations before final admission policy.

Preserve signed offsets, zero recovery state, scalar and vector velocities, exact damping order and all meaningful resets. Do not select positive owners solely from current defaults; finish fixture/mutation survey before narrowing old public values. Prepare checked focus/velocity/boom/history replacements together, keeping genuine critical-damping and collision calculations as explicit native kernels.

next_source_planning_tasks: Finish exact fixture/config mutation and feature-gated capture caller inventory, then resolve the remaining scalar/screen bound decisions from their actual successful contracts.
Review prospective constructor/operation failure behavior before editing: a failure must not mutate its owned record into a partly admitted replacement. No global transaction claim.

Keep existing collision/smoothing/camera tests and their inputs, order and assertions; no new tests/helpers/assertions. Select existing hosted commands only after this entire source family is complete.

additional_checked_consumers.angle_candidate: animation/authored_angle.rs::SignedAngleDegrees already admits finite signed degrees and exposes final native radians. Reuse rather than adding a camera-only degree type, after checking its current BodyAngle diagnostic classification for the broader role.
additional_checked_consumers.closure_requirement: Carry camera physical fields through obstruction observations until actual manifest serialization/formatting; P17 is not a reason to erase these freshly migrated values in an internal observation. Inspect tuple target/transform handoffs, named record ownership and yaw producer boundaries before implementation.
additional_checked_consumers.existing_unit_selection: Candidate existing command: cargo test --locked --package adventuresim-tactical-client --lib --features remote-types camera:: -- --test-threads=1. Confirm actual filter/nonempty results on hosted CI only after source completion. Current 6 collision,3 smoothing and2 mode/aim tests are source-read, not executed evidence.
additional_checked_consumers.existing_fixture_inputs: Wall/corner/focus-lag cases, doorway/ceiling/stair sweeps across 3 aspect ratios and yaw/pitch samples, full-distance open space, held/monotonic recovery, blend reversal, 30/144-step damping, sweet-spot bounds and distinct muzzle-hit identity assertions remain unchanged.

capture_receiver_recheck.head: 66d90cacc2d95012556ec6730a35fc8a5fbfe31a
capture_receiver_recheck.scope: Source planning only; no P08 implementation.
observed_edges: view_camera.rs tree/rock/ground/LOD helpers return positional native point/target/up tuples; lit helpers return Transform plus native Vec3 target. camera_for_view composes these.
camera_obstruction.rs resolve/frame/placement returns Transform, native Vec3 target and CameraObstructionObservation; capture_terrain.rs forwards that packet.
tactical_scene_viewer.rs update/capture path receives all those packets and retains target until camera_target.to_array() in capture metadata.
CameraObstructionObservation currently retains desired_metres/resolved_metres as f32. They are internal observations, not yet the serialization boundary.
plan_closure: Use a named checked scene-camera view/placement record across capture helper APIs; retain scene Position and direction guarantees until actual Transform/looking-at and serialized array adapters. Composite admission must handle unusable view geometry without placeholder observations.

Carry the gameplay rig physical owners into the two obstruction observation lengths; convert only in actual manifest serialization/formatting. P17 does not excuse internal primitive forwarding for these newly migrated values.

Trace capture ground_eye_position/ground_eye_target and other participating retained camera positions to their actual framework/admission producer before claiming the return-record migration complete.

Use the existing finite signed authored-degree owner where the units match, preserving degree wire values and final native radian conversion. Its existing BodyAngle error classification needs explicit correction or mapping for the camera role, not a duplicate camera angle type.

Keep ordinary hit predicates distinct from role/availability states. Optional current observations must own correlated entity/normal and entity/point payloads; do not introduce unavailable-value zero sentinels.
capture_receiver_recheck.unverified: Not a claim that every independent browser/art-demo orbit camera is in this connected producer graph. Resolve any actual shared handoff during full caller enumeration; no original exit is dropped.

current_main_owner_reuse.scope: Source planning only while the same P06 job is live; no P08 implementation, acceptance or new audit wave.

observed_contracts.Metres: Transparent f32 unit wrapper. from_metres and derived Deserialize retain any represented f32; no finite or sign admission is imposed. This is not a new f64 or checked finite owner.
observed_contracts.Ratio: Transparent unbounded f32 unit wrapper. Explicitly leaves application bounds to the record. It is not interchangeable with checked UnitInterval or a signed per-second derivative.
observed_contracts.AccelerationVector: Model-frame acceleration [f32;3], no checked finite policy; cannot serve as scene-frame linear velocity.
observed_contracts.other_units: RadiansPerMetre, TurnsPerMetre and PerMetre have distinct dimensions from camera linear velocity or signed blend fraction per second.

decisions: Keep canonical geometry SignedLength for finite signed camera distances/offsets. Do not silently weaken its contract to the unchecked Metres wrapper or add a camera-only equivalent length. Unit-only and checked application contracts are distinct.

Reuse Ratio for actual dimensionless coefficients or inside private checked screen-window/screen-error records. Those records must own finiteness and nonnegative-window admission; do not add an upper bound of one to window extents or use metres. Do not retain arbitrary Ratio inputs without completing that record admission.

Keep canonical SignedSpeed for scalar metres-per-second. The new upstream units provide no scene-frame velocity owner, so the earlier shared scene-coordinate owner proposal remains to be resolved from actual consumers.
The signed blend derivative still needs the correct per-second role; neither Ratio nor nonnegative ResponseRate/PhaseCorrectionRate matches it.
P18 f64 statistics cannot be quantized into the newly added f32 Metres or Ratio wrappers. Check precision and role again during that family; no f64 owner is established by this math-unit addition.
current_main_owner_reuse.remaining: P06/current P02 selected hosted checks/artifacts and relevant official baseline reductions must be accepted before P08 source edits. Existing camera fixture inputs, native arithmetic/reset/hysteresis and all20 original exits remain binding.
